review.posthog_relevance: Adds a shared React component and its tests for a feedback banner related to the Broadcasts feature, alongside minor removals and conditional rendering. This supports the UI entry point and basic behavior checks for the feedback banner.
review.reason: Adds a new React component, FeaturePreviewFeedbackBanner, with its implementation, tests, and shared usage. P1.F1.H1 adds the banner component; P1.F2.H1 adds tests; P1.F3.H1 adds implementation checks; P1.F4.H1 removes inline survey capture and adds the shared banner. This is a localized, bounded implementation of a UI component and its tests.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the underlying survey API, configuration, backend ingestion, or workflow implementation, so end-to-end production readiness and broader systemic benefit cannot be established. No tier 2 or 3 evidence is present.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the underlying survey API, the survey configuration, or the backend ingestion. It also does not include the workflow or broadcast feature implementation, only the feedback banner. This makes it impossible to establish a complete, end-to-end implementation or to distinguish whether the survey and banner are production-ready or still,

observations.behavior: Adds a new React component, BroadcastsFeaturePreview, that renders a feedback banner for the Broadcasts feature.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a UI entry point for the feedback banner, passing survey and surface configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds a test file, FeaturePreviewFeedbackBanner.test.tsx, with four tests: records rating, records feedback, no impression for dismissed, no duplicate rating.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the banner records survey and feedback events correctly and does not record impressions for dismissed banners or duplicate ratings.

observations.behavior: Adds the FeaturePreviewFeedbackBanner component implementation, including state, event capture, and UI, with checks for dismissed status and duplicate ratings.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks dismissed status before recording an impression, and checks rating before recording a second rating, preventing duplicate submissions.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, benefit or tier inferred.
